history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration strengthen its role and capacity to provide guidance on construction projects of special political missions and expedite the development of appropriate thresholds, criteria and evaluation methods for construction projects that would be subject to the review of the Global Asset Management Policy Service.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The budget guide for special political missions for 2027 (which was issued in February 2026) included guidance for the missions on projects requiring review by the Global Asset Management Policy Service. A project with a cost above $10 million and a duration of 2–5 years will be subject to the Service’s review and guidance. The Service will provide targeted guidance to missions with large-scale multi-year projects that are currently at either the planning or the implementation stage. Special political missions are requested to contact the Service if they have such construction projects under implementation or to be proposed in the upcoming budget period. Required resources for this oversight and support function will be charged to the construction project concerned, as is the case with the capital construction projects.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has issued the budget guide for special political missions for 2027, in which thresholds for review of construction projects by the Global Asset Management Policy Service were defined, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
